title: Senior / Staff Security Engineer
description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

At Linear, we are committed to quality. Security is an essential part of that quality — not a layer that we add later, but something we build in from the start. We have a foundational security program we're proud of but, as Linear evolves our product and scales into enterprise, there's meaningful work ahead: staying ahead of vulnerabilities as our attack surface grows, responding fast and cleanly when incidents happen, and hardening our product and infrastructure. As Security Engineer at Linear, you'll be operating in a high-autonomy role with real scope, doing hands-on security work across the product and infrastructure we build.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

Depending on your experience / skillset and our broader priorities, you could:

 - Operate, automate, and extend vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, prioritize, and drive remediation across product, infrastructure, and dependencies, and keep the program’s SLAs meaningful rather than theoretical

 - Run our bug bounty program: triage incoming reports, validate severity, work with engineering on fixes, and keep researcher relationships prof…

title: Senior Sales Engineer
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 As a Senior Sales Engineer, you’ll combine your technical aptitude, exceptional communication skills, and creative problem solving to help enterprise merchants design and implement scalable, reliable solutions on the Affirm platform. You’ll support pre-sale activities by leading technical discovery, analyzing requirements, and identifying well-architected solutions, while playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward.
 Staff Sales Engineers are part of the Merchant Engineering team and work closely with Affirm’s Sales, Engineering, and Product teams. You will work cross-functionally to develop merchant solutions, serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, identify product enhancements, and help build internal processes that scale.
 What You'll Do
 Technical Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert on Affirm’s integration solutions, demonstrating deep understanding of merchant checkout, customer journeys, and the competitive landscape. Making the most compelling technical case for Affirm to merchants. Consistently demonstrate your technical expertise and knowledge of Affirm’s product suite through developing and articulating compelling technical narratives that map Affirm’s capabilities to merchant systems, increasing solution scope and long-term platform adoption.
 Solution Development: Architect elegant solutions addressing specific customer challenges, including complex integrations and customizations. As necessary, think outside-the-box to design and architect end-to-end solutions that address complex merchant challenges, including advanced integrations and customizations. Evaluate tradeoffs across merchant constraints, platform capabilities, and non-functional requirements, and design tailored solutions aligned with each merchant’s business and tech…

title: Senior Project Manager, Professional Services
description:
Professional Services Senior Project Manager

Location: UK (Remote)
Department: Professional Services (PS)

About the Job 
Rubrik Professional Services is looking for a high-energy, strategic, and results-driven Senior Project Manager to lead complex, enterprise customer implementations and help shape the future of our delivery practice. In this role, you will be customer-facing, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure deployment success, business value realisation, and operational efficiency. You will own high-stakes client engagements end-to-end, bringing deep project management expertise to solve problems on the ground and drive customer outcomes with minimal oversight.

About You 
As a Senior Project Manager in our PS Organisation, you will drive impact primarily through hands-on delivery excellence, leadership, and practice enablement.

1. Client Delivery Excellence
● Drive Complex Engagements: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, concurrent, enterprise-level customer projects from kickoff to sign-off within fast-paced environments.
● Scope & Milestone Management: Prepare enterprise customers for deployment, establish clear success criteria, track deliverables, set targets, manage resources, and ensure project execution adheres to deadlines and budgets.
● Risk & Issue Governance: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks and technical dependencies, resolving issues autonomously before they escalate.
● Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the single point of contact and escalation owner for customer executives, cross-functional internal teams (Engineering, Customer Support, Sales), and third- party partners.

title: Support Engineer - Last Mile Delivery (f/m/d)
description:
Notre équipe Ship & Back recherche un·e Support Engineer (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille.

Au cœur de la Value Chain de Decathlon, l'équipe Last Mile Delivery propulse l'expérience sportive au niveau supérieur en garantissant une livraison fluide, rapide et fiable partout dans le monde. Composée d'une dizaine de passionné·es du produit et de la tech, notre mission est d'optimiser le cœur battant de la logistique e-commerce à travers 3 produits clés : Shipperbox (tracking et étiquettes transporteurs), RPM (référentiel des points relais) et Trackbox (assure la livraison des commandes e-commerce, leur suivi et leur performance). En rejoignant notre équipe à taille humaine, tu prendras le lead du support fonctionnel sur un périmètre stratégique, avec l'ambition de garantir une performance de livraison sans faille pour des millions d'utilisateur·rices.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

  • Animer et piloter le support fonctionnel et technique sur l'ensemble de notre scope (Shipperbox, RPM, Trackbox).
  • Incarner la voix de l'utilisateur·rice en garantissant une satisfaction client optimale au quotidien.
  • Adopter une démarche proactive : concevoir, déployer et maintenir des sondes et dispositifs de monitoring pour anticiper et détecter les dysfonctionnements avant l'impact métier.
  • Intervenir avec réactivité lors des incidents critiques et mener les analyses d'impact et de cause racine.
  • Structurer et appliquer des plans d'action post-incident rigoureux pour éliminer durablement la récurrence des problèmes.
  • Identifier les points critiques du scope fonctionnel pour optimiser continuellement la qualité de service et la robustesse de nos outils.
